description: Cambio climático is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Este indicador visualiza el comportamiento de ciertos fenómenos y variables climatológicas y su relación con algunos eventos específicos en salud, a partir del año 2009, haciendo un abordaje del fenómeno de El Niño Oscilación del Sur (ENOS), las variaciones de temperatura, la precipitación acumulada, eventos de interés en salud pública (respiratorios y vectoriales) y fenómenos ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Its tags are Salud Bogotá, Secretaria de Salud, salud, salud bogota. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
